# AudioSceneBypass <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AudioSceneBypass:Void scene:Int32, effect:Int32, bypass:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene` | In | Int32 | required | A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `effect` | In | Int32 | required | An effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect) or [AddChannelEffect](AddChannelEffect). Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `bypass` | In | Int32 | required | As for [AudioEffectBypass](AudioEffectBypass). |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets whether a bus effect is bypassed when the scene is applied. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* [BlendAudioScene](BlendAudioScene) bypasses the effect from a weight of half way toward the scene that bypasses it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
AudioSceneBypass outside, reverb, True
AudioSceneBypass cave, reverb, False
```
